reviews.comment: Took her at UTA. Dr. Spiers is super helpful and caring, and her class has a very friendly and relaxed atmosphere. There's only 2 assigned speeches, one solo one group. The workload is usually light, with the end of the semester being more stressful. She's a tough grader, but still helpful and always eager to answer questions. Enjoyed having her!

textbook is free! hardest part of the class was the 2 presentations. one is individual and the other is an assigned group project. professor is fantastic and makes class very fun and breeds class to be a community. easiest class ive ever presented in. professor is super helpful and willing to help! effort is key.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: She is very outgoing and accessible in her office hours. She made me look forward to the class, so as a stem major that's honestly the best thing a professor could do for me. Pros: light homework, easy exams, extra credit. Cons: heavy grading on all presentations, you must practice them or you'll fail the class, sometimes pop quiz
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: New hire at UTA. I enjoyed having her, she was always available for office hours and wanted you to try your best to get the most out of this class. Always has a positive attitude. Tough grader for the presentations but if you try you'll get a good grade. Kinda a slow grader
She's so sweet!! Really like how her and the other professor bounce off each other. She'll help you in and out of class.

New hire at UTA. Dual teaching with another professor. Spiers did nothing! When she did speak she "yells" at students in a scolding manner. Come to her with a problem & she reverts back to what's wrong w/you.  Easy class, but for a Sr level class, I expected more. Learned nothing from her. Would not take her again!

Professor Spiers has high emotional intelligence; however, I'm not a fan of how she conducts her classes.  Too inexperienced, she doesn't respond well to adversity. Furthermore, she often singles people out to make examples out of them, inappropriate behavior coming from a college professor. The class isn't horrible but wouldn't take it again.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Spiers is one of the best professors I've ever had. I had her class Spring semester 2022 and thoroughly enjoyed it. She very clearly cares about her students and job and creates a wonderful environment to learn in. Also her dog is cute.

Took her class in the seasonal event Spring in the year of 2022, she brought a caring and friendly atmosphere to the class. She made the lectures entertaining enough, had a few pop quizzes over the material read, and had interesting projects. Good teacher that made a class good.

Professor Spiers was an awesome professor for Interview Principles & Practices. She truly cares about each student and makes an effort to get to know everyone. The assignments are relatively easy, you just have to get each part of your interview assignment done on time and put in some effort. She's awesome!!!

I took her in fall of 2021 and she was amazing. She cares a lot about her students. She is really easy to talk to and if you need help with anything at all she will help you. She wants her students to get good grades and helps her students to achieve that. I would take a class taught by her again without any hesitation.

I got an A in this class but that is the only reason I would take Professor Spiers again. At the end of the semester, some of my assignments never even got graded???? She would cancel class when it was convenient for her, but students are only allowed two absences. What was expected of us was NEVER clear.

Attendance is no joke, but she is super understanding and helpful. She is willing to work with you and help you in any way, shape, or form that she can. If she could teach all my classes, I'd be on the dean's list.

Alaina is one of the bestt Proffesors I have ever had. She really cares about her students in and out of class. Comm 210 was so much fun , but don't think you can get an A without any work. She knows her stuff and will expect you to produce good work. I would take her for sure.
Professor Spiers was an awesome professor! She made group projects and this class so much fun. All the work was enjoyable and I always enjoyed doing assignments.
